description:
Validate a single email: status, sub-status, and hygiene fields.
When to use: When the user wants deliverability or list-hygiene for one address (not bulk upload).
Parameters: email — address to validate; ipAddress (optional) — subscriber IP if known; timeout (optional, 3-60) — seconds ZeroBounce may spend before answering unknown; activityData (optional) — include activity data; verifyPlus (optional) — deeper verification where available; domainInfo (optional) — website availability and WHOIS registrant for the domain; usePost (optional) — send as POST.
CREDITS: Each successful call spends ZeroBounce account credits. Confirm with the user before calling unless they explicitly asked for validation, enrichment, or activity data.

activityData.description: Include activity data on the validation result

domainInfo.description: Add domain_website_exists and domain_registrant_company_name (WHOIS) for the domain

ipAddress.description: Optional IP address of the user (helps improve accuracy)

usePost.description: When true, uses POST /validate with form-encoded body (same parameters as GET)

verifyPlus.description: Use Verify+ validation for this request

name: validate
title: Validate email
